map.输入销售或营销漏斗各环节（访客、线索、客户）的人数，分析各级转化率与整体转化效率: Enter headcounts at each sales/marketing funnel stage (visitors, leads, customers) to analyze conversion rates per stage and overall efficiency, locating the stage leaking the most.
map.把访客→线索→商机→客户各级人数填入算整体转化。: Fill in headcount at each stage - visitor, lead, opportunity, customer - to get the overall conversion.
map.找转化塌方最狠的一级优先补。: Fix the stage where conversion collapses most, that is the priority.
map.对比两个销售团队的漏斗效率。: Compare funnel efficiency across two sales teams.
map.：访客 10000 → 线索 2000 → 商机 500 → 客户 200，整体: : visitors 10,000 -> leads 2,000 -> opportunities 500 -> customers 200, overall conversion = 200/10000 = 2%; stage rates 20%/25%/40%, with opportunity-to-customer at 40% on the low side, so drill the sales script.
map.：团队 A 访客 10000 转化 200（2%），团队 B 同样访客转化 32: : team A had 10,000 visitors and 200 conversions (2%), team B the same visitors with 320 conversions (3.2%); B's funnel is tighter, so replicate its SOP.

map.整体转化低先改哪级？: Which stage to fix first when overall conversion is low?
map.改「转化率低且流量大」的级，杠杆最大；别死磕顶部大流量低转化环节。: Fix the stage with "low conversion and high traffic" for the biggest leverage; do not obsess over the top-of-funnel stage with huge traffic and low conversion.
map.漏斗能算金额吗？: Can the funnel be computed in money?
map.各级乘对应客单价可估金额漏斗，定位丢钱最多的环节更直观。: Multiplying each stage by its order value gives a monetary funnel, making it clearer where the most money leaks.
